validation.notes: Asset lives on vi.tsinghua.edu.cn, Tsinghua University's own Visual Identity (VI) site, published by the Party Committee Publicity Department / Culture Office (address block on the page: 清华大学党委宣传部, 100084 Beijing). It is the standard horizontal lockup (seal omitted, horizontal Chinese standard wordmark + English 'Tsinghua University' wordmark) in the university's official 标准色 purple, exactly as the VI guide requires. Downloaded (1400x600 JPEG, 56163 bytes) and visually inspected: clean logo artwork on a white ground, no page chrome, no crop. Identity is unambiguous: the scholarship page states 'Type B generally refers to CGS programs responsible by Chinese universities under the CGS-Chinese University Program', so Tsinghua University is the responsible/awarding body for this record, and Tsinghua is named in the record title itself.

records.title: Atomic Energy Scholarship Program of China 2026

validation.notes: Same official Tsinghua University VI asset as record 244 (intentional duplicate: one provider, one official source). Provenance is airtight - vi.tsinghua.edu.cn is the university's own Visual Identity site. Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH purely on identity mapping: the page states the programme is run jointly by the China Atomic Energy Authority (CAEA) and the Ministry of Education with the China Scholarship Council, so Tsinghua is the host/delivering institution rather than the funder. I deliberately did not use a CAEA or MOE mark - those are co-funders, i.e. partner branding, not this record's provider - which is the same judgement LG-028 applied to the Mastercard Foundation at Sciences Po. No CAEA logo was verified as a fetchable official asset in any case.

validation.notes: jaducdn.leeds.ac.uk is the University of Leeds' own asset CDN - the live www.leeds.ac.uk pages load their design-system assets from https://jaducdn.leeds.ac.uk/uol-ds/1.0.21/ (confirmed on www.leeds.ac.uk/media-relations). uol-logo.svg is the primary University of Leeds logo shipped in the University's own official design system bundle (designsystem.leeds.ac.uk/assets.zip, entry img/uol-logo.svg, 2197 bytes, byte-identical to the CDN copy). Identity is unambiguous - the University of Leeds is the awarding institution.

agent_notes.summary: 5/5 records covered. 5 recovered, 0 not_found, 0 rejected. Confidence: HIGH 3 (244, 329, 574), MEDIUM 2 (317, 318). All five image_url values were GET-verified 200 with an image/* Content-Type and were downloaded and visually inspected.
integration_notes: Records 244 and 318 intentionally share one image_url. Tsinghua University is the official_source for both and no per-scheme mark exists for either; this matches the duplicate-URL pattern other LG shards have reported.

DEAD LINK (record 329): studies.ku.dk/education/student-life/finances-and-scholarships/scholarships-for-international-students returns HTTP 404. The live official page is https://www.ku.dk/studies/admission/scholarships-for-full-degree-students, which does carry the Danish Government Scholarship text. Any deadline shard covering record 329 needs the same substitution.

Tsinghua publishes NO usable positive-colour logo on www.tsinghua.edu.cn: both image/logo159.png and image/logo180.png are white-on-transparent reverse variants for the site's dark header, and yz.tsinghua.edu.cn/image/logo.png is the same. Any other shard covering a yz.tsinghua.edu.cn record must go to vi.tsinghua.edu.cn (the official Visual Identity site) for a usable purple or black mark.

UCPH publishes no full logo on ku.dk pages at all - the header logo is an inline <svg> with no fetchable URL. The only fetchable official asset is cdn.ku.dk/styles/<version>/img/print_logo.png; the Design Guide's own red seal is a CMS crop with the bottom ~40% of the seal missing, so it should not be used by other shards either.
